account.date: account creation date stored as full DATE (YYYY-MM-DD), not YYMMDD as originally described
card.issued: credit card issue date stored as full DATE (YYYY-MM-DD), not YYMMDD as originally described
disp.type: type of disposition with values 'OWNER' and 'DISPONENT' only; 'USER' is not a valid type
loan.payments: monthly payment amount in currency, not a count of months as 'unit: month' suggests
trans.type: 'PRIJEM' means credit, 'VYDAJ' means withdrawal, and 'VYBER' is a subtype of withdrawal (cash withdrawal), not described originally
district.a4: population count or similar numeric demographic measure (description missing)
district.a5: number of municipalities or related count/statistic (description missing)
district.a6: number of districts or related count/statistic (description missing)
district.a7: number of regions or related count/statistic (description missing)
district.a8: additional numeric code or count related to municipality/district/region hierarchy (description missing)
